messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — I'm planning to cut the release-stamp branch at 11:30am PT for the v0.15.0 family. Please confirm your repo's version bump PRs and changelog entries are merged (or post PR numbers). I'll perform a short freeze from 11:25-11:40 to avoid mid-cut changes.

maria: Runtime PR is open: https://git.example.com/redwood/runtime/pull/342 — changelog in the PR, commit 9f3d2a7. CI is queued, should be green before cutoff.

devon: API bumped in PR 339 and changelog added: https://git.example.com/redwood/api/pull/339. No breaking changes.

lee: SDK needs a minor semver bump (0.14.3 -> 0.15.0). Draft PR 341 waiting on API proto change — is that merged?

sam: API proto change landed in #339 (merged). Plan is to stamp tags in this order: runtime -> api -> console -> sdk. Typical workflow: rebase SDK on merged API, run tests, then stamp. Stamping script I use below — follow order and wait for canary health before pushing next tag.

sam: ```
# local stamp flow
git checkout -b release/v0.15.0-stamp
./scripts/stamp-version.sh v0.15.0
git commit -am "chore(release): v0.15.0"
git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "v0.15.0"
git push origin --tags
```

maria: I'll kick off the runtime canary immediately after tagging and watch telemetry. If cpu/latency or error rate spikes >2x baseline I'll revert the tag and notify. I'm adding a rollback tag strategy (v0.14.4-fallback).

anya: I can run the smoke test checklist during 11:30-12:00 PT and monitor logs/dashboards. Ping me when you start the stamp.

devon: Console changelog PR 345 is queued (minor copy tweak). I'll merge by 11:10 to give time for CI.

lee: Rebased SDK branch onto main after #339. PR 341 now passing unit tests locally, pushing CI. If green I'll request review and merge before 11:20.

deploy-bot: Canary build started for runtime:v0.15.0 — build id: build-8732, started at 2026-03-17T18:31:00Z.

sam: :thumbsup: Thanks — if anything blocks merge by 11:20 call it out here. Otherwise I'll proceed at 11:30 and post a short summary once tags are pushed.

maria: Quick note — I'll also smoke the KV cache warm-up stage; if cold-start token latency > 150ms in canary I won't promote.

lee: CI passed, PR 341 is ready for merge from my side.

devon: Merged console PR 345 at 11:05.

sam: OK cutting the branch now, starting stamp flow. Will post back with pushed tags and tag SHAs.

sam: Pushed tags: runtime v0.15.0 -> sha: a1b2c3d, api v0.15.0 -> sha: d4e5f6g, console v0.15.0 -> sha: h7i8j9k, sdk v0.15.0 -> sha: l0m1n2o. Monitoring canary for 15m.

anya: Running smoke tests now — initial checks good.

maria: Canary runtime metrics stable; promoting to wider canary.

sam: All tags pushed and promoted. Will follow up with changelog consolidated PR and release notes in the release board. Thanks everyone.

lee: :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary scale-up completed for runtime:v0.15.0 — scale to 5 instances at 2026-03-17T18:45:00Z.
